prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single universally “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck. The best lawyer for you depends on the facts of your crash, the injuries, whether the case will be settled or needs a trial, and how you want to work with an attorney.

How to pick the best lawyer for your car wreck
- Experience with car wrecks and serious-injury cases (not just general practice).  
- Trial experience and a track record of settlements/verdicts in similar cases.  
- Local Houston/county court experience and relationships with local experts.  
- Clear communication: timely updates, explains options in plain language.  
- Resources to pay upfront costs (investigators, crash reconstruction, medical experts).  
- Good client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell).  
- Clean disciplinary record with the State Bar of Texas.  
- Contingency-fee arrangement (you pay only if they recover), and clear fee/cost terms.

Where to look
- Texas State Bar attorney search (to check license/discipline).  
- Review sites: Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Google/Yelp.  
- Personal referrals from friends, medical providers, or local support groups.

Questions to ask in a free consultation
1. How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled?  
2. What percentage of your cases go to trial?  
3. What outcomes have you achieved for similar injuries?  
4. Who in your office will handle my case day-to-day?  
5. What is your fee (contingency %) and how are costs handled?  
6. How often and by what method will you update me?  
7. Will you use outside experts (reconstruction, medical) if needed?  
8. How long do you expect my case to take?  
9. Can you provide references from former clients?  
10. Any conflicts or barriers to taking my case?

Immediate steps after a wreck (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical care and follow doctor instructions — medical records are critical.  
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, injuries, scene; witness names/contacts.  
- Report the crash to police and get the crash report number.  
- Preserve vehicle damage (don’t do major repairs until advised).  
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without consulting an attorney.  
- Keep receipts for expenses and records of time missed from work.

Typical fee and timing
- Most car-wreck PI attorneys work on contingency (commonly ~33%–40% of recovery plus expenses, but this varies).  
- Cases can settle in weeks/months for minor injuries; severe or disputed cases often take 1–2 years (or longer) if litigation is required.

If you want, I can:
- Help you find and compare a short list of well-reviewed Houston car-accident lawyers (I’ll need your ZIP code or neighborhood and a brief case summary), or  
- Draft an email/phone script you can use when calling firms for consultations.

Which would you prefer?
